chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah, from al-Fadl ibn Shazan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:
Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: By Allah, that which you look forward to will not come about until you are distinguished or tested, until only the best of you remain.
“Do you think that you will be left [as you are] while Allah has not yet known those who strive among you and do not take other than Allah and His Messenger and the believers as intimates?”
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the expected event to occur according to Imam al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him) elucidates that the awaited deliverance will not manifest until the community undergoes a rigorous spiritual filtration, leaving only the 'Ander' (the elite or most refined) who have proven their steadfastness. This narration, found in Al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, underscores the Shia doctrine of *Tubra* (divine testing) during the Major Occultation, where true faith is distinguished from mere nominal adherence through trials. The Imam’s recitation of the verse highlights that God’s knowledge of the truly striving and patient is actualized through this period of tribulation, reinforcing the necessity of spiritual purification before the appearance of the Imam.
